response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and systems programming, and recent exposure to MCP and agentic workflow tooling. However, the resume shows no demonstrated experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, structured GenAI data pipelines, multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph/CrewAI), or cloud-platform AI system design, and no evidence of leading customer-facing technical discovery sessions — all core, explicitly required qualifications for this Staff FDE GenAI role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering background (15+ years) spanning full-stack, systems, and embedded development
Recent hands-on work with MCP and agentic infrastructure tooling at re:cinq
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and workshop/teaching experience
concerns: No evidence of RAG, vector database, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
No demonstrated cloud-platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) AI system design work despite some AWS CDK exposure
No clear track record of customer-facing technical discovery or enterprise consulting engagements

key_factors.factor: No customer-facing technical discovery/FDE-style consulting experience
Strong general engineering seniority and recent AI-agent tooling exposure
